answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an AI-agent economy can enforce time-locked collateral bonds, creating a velvet rope admission threshold throughout the staking horizon. Agents must deposit escrowed tokens to participate, forcing an attacker to incur the verifiable opportunity cost of illiquid capital per identity. Once funds are unbonded, the retired credential becomes an unusable relic. However, this mechanism cannot prevent capital-rich cartels from funding multiple identities.
